## Problem & Context
<!-- What is broken, who or what is affected, and how was the issue observed? Link the issue or incident. -->

## Reproduction
<!-- Provide the smallest reliable reproduction, including inputs or conditions. -->

## Root Cause
<!-- Explain why the existing behaviour occurred. Distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions. -->

## Fix
<!-- Explain how the change addresses the underlying cause and why this approach is appropriate. -->

## Verification & Regression
- [ ] Confirmed the failure before the fix (or documented why this was not possible)
- [ ] Verified the expected behaviour after the fix
- [ ] Added or updated regression test(s)
- [ ] Checked related flows and potential side effects

## Known Limitations
<!-- List remaining risks or follow-ups, or state "None known". -->

## Self-Check
- [ ] Change is minimal and focused on the defect
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or sensitive personal data added or logged
